facts.fact: 在 Dry Dock 只是喝开场酒，三个室友决定跟 Elliot 一伙继续去夜店。
facts.anchor: After what had turned out to be just pre-drinks at the Dry Dock, the girls had decided they were going on to a club with Elliot and his mates.

facts.fact: Olivia 以经前不适为借口独自回家。
facts.anchor: ‘I think I’m premenstrual, actually. You guys have a good one.’

facts.fact: 验尸报道称 Emily 血液里有酒精与安非他命，据信与死因无关。
facts.anchor: Alcohol and amphetamines were found in her blood, believed to be unrelated to the cause of death.

facts.fact: 死亡时间被定为 1999 年 12 月 31 日晚 8 点到 9 点之间。
facts.anchor: Time of death was between 8 p.m. and 9 p.m. on 31 December 1999.

facts.fact: Elliot 的继兄回信说，朋友认为那位讲师叫 Dr Barkley（拼写不确定）。
facts.anchor: Just asked a mate. They think Dr Barkley??

facts.fact: Olivia 最终搜到在 Cardiff 教历史的 Aiden Berkeley 博士。
facts.anchor: he came upon a Dr Aiden Berkeley who taught History at Cardiff.

facts.fact: 他的网页简历确认他曾在利兹任教直到 2000 年。
facts.anchor: The biography on his web page confirmed he had taught in Leeds until 2000.

facts.fact: Elliot 醉后独自找上门，说自己是来看她的。
facts.anchor: ‘Came to see you,’ he smirked playfully.

facts.fact: Elliot 要求看“现场”，也就是 Olivia 的卧室。
facts.anchor: ‘Listen,’ he went on, sounding sincere for perhaps the first time since she’d met him. ‘Would you mind if I saw the room? My stepbrother’s told me so much about this, it was kind of a big deal for the guys who were here when it happened.

facts.fact: Elliot 不请自坐到了她的床上。
facts.anchor: She handed him the glass and he took a sip, grimaced, then seated himself on her bed, uninvited.
